methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched with WebFetch on 2026-06-15. Where a vendor renders its pricing table via JavaScript and the values are not present in the fetched HTML (Crowdin), monthly USD prices were corroborated against multiple third-party trackers (costbench.com, tekpon.com) that agree on the same figures. Prices published in EUR (Tolgee, Weblate, Texterify) are converted to USD at 1 EUR approx 1.09 USD and the source currency is noted in plan notes. Transifex Starter/Growth prices are the lowest published word-count tier and scale upward with hosted word volume (noted per plan). Quote-only/Enterprise tiers with no published price are recorded as monthlyUsd null. Smartling publishes no platform subscription price (sized to translation volume) so only its free Core and custom Enterprise tiers are listed. Compliance flags are set true only where the vendor explicitly states the certification on its own security/compliance page; otherwise null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
